assessment: The source reports C/Omega=-1820 Hz/(b mu_N), the preferred second-order-corrected C=113 Hz with Omega=-0.062 b mu_N, and the first-order-only alternative C=-45.10 Hz with Omega=0.0248 b mu_N. The card directly encodes Omega=C/(C/Omega), preserves the calculated central conversion factor, distinguishes both correction treatments in applicability, and anchors every value, control, readout, and two-point domain to the relevant lines. The central deterministic calculation reproduces both reported octupole-moment values to their stated precision.

issues.detail: The -45.10 Hz point intentionally represents a less accurate first-order-only treatment; it is retained only because the card and source label that condition explicitly.

controls.definition: Magnetic-octupole hyperfine constant C of the 173Yb+ 2D3/2 state.
controls.name: hyperfine_constant_C

applicability.statement: C=113 Hz is the source's value including first- and second-order energy corrections; the resulting octupole moment is approximately -0.062 b*mu_N.
C=-45.10 Hz is the first-order-only value obtained when second-order corrections are disregarded; it gives approximately 0.0248 b*mu_N and is not the source's preferred accurate treatment.
